say:3:1511118002:0.text: Was that wheat stalk part of a trap? But that aura is definitely your power...
say:3:1511118002:0.source_cn: 难道麦穗上的魔法是陷阱？可是那种气息明明就是你的力量呀……
say:3:1511118002:0.male: Was that wheat stalk part of a trap? But that aura is definitely your power...
say:3:1511118002:0.female: Was that wheat stalk part of a trap? But that aura is definitely your power...

narration:6:1511118003:0.source_cn: 你向大家讲述了你的穿越和穿越后所经历的一切……

narration:7:1511118004:0.text: —from the moment you were mistaken for a god, to the final battle with the fallen Hunting Goddess.
narration:7:1511118004:0.source_cn: ——从被错认为神，到最终击败堕落的狩猎神
narration:7:1511118004:0.male: —from the moment you were mistaken for a god, to the final battle with the fallen Hunting Goddess.
narration:7:1511118004:0.female: —from the moment you were mistaken for a goddess, to the final battle with the fallen Hunting Goddess.

narration:8:1511118005:0.text: As the story unfolds, you slowly realize:
narration:8:1511118005:0.source_cn: 而在叙述中，你发现，经历了如此漫长的旅程
narration:8:1511118005:0.male: As the story unfolds, you slowly realize:
narration:8:1511118005:0.female: As the story unfolds, you slowly realize:

narration:9:1511118006:0.text: While you lived through a long and winding journey, only a few minutes have passed for Satrana and the others.
narration:9:1511118006:0.source_cn: 这段时间，在萨忒娜他们看来仅仅过了几分钟而已……
narration:9:1511118006:0.male: While you lived through a long and winding journey, only a few minutes have passed for Satrana and the others.
narration:9:1511118006:0.female: While you lived through a long and winding journey, only a few minutes have passed for Satrana and the others.

say:12:1511118007:0.text: By the stars! You actually defeated a goddess?!
say:12:1511118007:0.source_cn: 天哪……你、你竟然杀了一位神明！
say:12:1511118007:0.male: By the stars! You actually defeated a goddess?!
say:12:1511118007:0.female: By the stars! You actually defeated a goddess?!

say:13:1511118008:0.text: There's no record of that goddess here. Perhaps her name was lost over time...
say:13:1511118008:0.source_cn: 沙之书没有记录狩猎神的名号，可能是在传承的过程中遗失了……

say:14:1511118009:0.text: As for the Arcadian Rift... it's not in the Sandscript Temple. I've never even heard of it. Maybe it goes by a different name now.
say:14:1511118009:0.source_cn: 以及你所说的阿卡迪亚裂隙……不仅沙之书未曾记载，我也从...

say:15:1511118010:0.text: Wait—look at the Wanderer's Mural! <style="highlight">It's changed!</style>

narration:20:15011104:0.text: You examine the Wanderer's Mural once more and realize the missing parts have been restored.
narration:20:15011104:0.source_cn: 你们再次观察行迹长卷，惊觉之前缺损的已被复原。
